files.initialValue:
version: 2
jobs:
  validate:
    needs: []
    steps:
      -
        access:
          environment: "production"
          policy: "identity.yaml"
      -
        checkout:
          ref: "candidate"
      -
        setup:
          runtime: "24"
      -
        install:
          mode: "locked"
      -
        check:
          name: "unit"
    pool: "release"
  build:
    needs:
      - "validate"
    steps:
      -
        checkout:
          ref: "candidate"
      -
        setup:
          runtime: "24"
      -
        install:
          mode: "locked"
      -
        check:
          name: "lint"
      -
        check:
          name: "unit"
      -
        build:
          artifact: "app"
      -
        upload:
          artifact: "app"
  release:
    needs:
      - "build"
    steps:
      -
        download:
          artifact: "app"
      -
        access:
          environment: "production"
          policy: "identity.yaml"
      -
        deploy:
          artifact: "app"
          environment: "production"
    pool: "release"

origins:
  - "*"
repositories:
  - "*"
branches:
  - "*"
environments:
  - "*"
permissions:
  - "*"
secrets:
  - "secret://production-deploy"
  - "secret://database-admin"
trustedPool: false
extensions:
  - "*"
export const checkoutTotal = (prices) => prices.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0);

cases.description: The intended release must retain only its required authority.

cases.description: Another repository presents a mainline-looking identity.

cases.description: A feature branch requests production authority.
